index_policy.lookup_values: Original numeric IDs, ascending; all records retained, including placeholders and internal records.
index_policy.by_name: Exact cp936-decoded source name; values are lists because names are not unique. Reference by ID after choosing a record.
index_policy.by_type_subtype: Original type and subtype bytes joined with a colon; categories do not assign unrecovered mechanics.
index_policy.by_allowed_role: Three-digit numeric role ID for each set bit in the raw uint32 role mask. This source lookup does not enable items or assert usable behavior.
index_policy.availability: Source indexes are independent of runtime activation. config/items.json remains the only editable parameter catalog.

equipment_admission.scope: Menu equip/link capability only; no inventory grant, party ownership or special passive is inferred.

item_capability_admission.field_scope: 47D960 restores admitted deterministic HP/MP fields; zero-field status cures cannot succeed or consume in the field.
item_capability_admission.battle_scope: 41B3C0 calls 508BB0 then displays the source effect; consumes only on successful status removal or recovery.
item_capability_admission.passive_scope: 4451C0 -> 47A6A0 scans equipment and retained sockets in native group/entry order; 508BB0 preserves duplicate-before-RNG and inclusive chance. Mode6 blocks only matching incoming status IDs, never ticks or renders, and does not revive or apply its dormant numeric payload.

catalog.compatibility: The original eight chapter IDs retain their contracts. Registered source grants enable verified numeric equipment, native mode1 cures, and mode6 equipment/crystal immunity. Admission never grants inventory.
catalog.unknown_fields: Prices, crafting recipes, crystal insertion/removal and special effects are not assigned semantics from names; original bytes remain in raw_hex.

native_rules.equipment_group: weapon: group 0; type 2: definition byte +0x25; entry 0
native_rules.equipment_resources: No raw HP/MP write in 0x47C250/0x47C760; 0x47CC30 replaces linked bonuses.
native_rules.use: 0x47D960 adds instance +0x0D to raw HP +0x30 and +0x15 to raw MP +0x38; clamps to raw maxima.
native_rules.consume: 0x47E150 consumes one on native success and compacts a zero stack.
native_rules.exploration_target_gate: 0x45C400 checks only role presence; 0x45CA50 calls 0x47E150 for the selected role.
native_rules.effective_resource_getters: 0x500350/0x500480 return raw plus linked bonuses without a zero clamp.
native_rules.battle_gauge: 0x50E7A0 resets gauge to zero; item flag bypasses skill checks in 0x503D80/88; 0x503F38 subtracts threshold.
native_rules.battle_target_gate: 0x41B3C0 permits recovered mode0/1 for immune byte0 and state<4; displayed HP is not an additional gate. Invalid targets consume no item.
native_rules.battle_consumption: 41B3C0 consumes only if 508BB0 or 47D960 returns success. Nonzero HP/MP restore succeeds even when full; mode1 no-match fails without consumption.
native_rules.status_removal: 508BB0 mode1 rejects duplicate id/mode1, otherwise clears the first matching ID and calls508300; no RNG or 508A90 contact-removal pass.

limitations: Static shipped binary evidence; original execution was not observed.
Battle item gauge and zero added preparation debt are native verified; live menu timing and animation completion remain remake adapters.

Only registered-source mode6 immunity passives and stat crystals are recovered; crafting, other passives and growth/revival item handlers remain unverified.
ID31 has a variable range and ID36 has a reversed range in the shipped source; they are retained rather than silently repaired.
